title: CD Deep Dive: Delivery Intelligence 360
subtitle: Everything continuous delivery in one place: DORA, velocity, services, environments and infrastructure, reliability and rollbacks, approvals and OPA policy gates, change calendar and inventory hygiene, with cross-view correlations and drill-through to every execution.

widget.text: **What's inside:** an executive DORA strip, then eight tabs — Executive & DORA, Velocity & Trends, Services, Environments & Infrastructure, Reliability & Rollbacks, Governance (approvals, OPA, runtime inputs), Change Calendar and Inventory. **How to use:** the date picker drives every widget; the Organization, Project, Service, Environment, Environment Type, Deployment Type, Pipeline and Status filters apply wherever the data carries that field (pipeline-level views honor Org/Project/Pipeline/Status). Click execution names in tables to open the run in Harness. Deployments = CD deployment stages; service-scoped widgets exclude custom stages with no service.

queries.query:
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${prj_filter_predicate} and ${pip_filter_predicate} and ${sts_filter_predicate}
| filter ${svc_filter_predicate} and ${env_filter_predicate} and ${ety_filter_predicate} and ${dty_filter_predicate}
| aggregate {
d.org_identifier as org,
d.project_identifier as project,
distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) as deployments,
round(100.0 * distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) / sum(distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id)) over (), 1) as share_of_total,
distinct_count(d.service_identifier) as services,
round(100.0 * count(case when d.stage_status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as success_rate,
round(100.0 * count(case when d.stage_status in ["FAILED", "ABORTED", "EXPIRED", "APPROVAL_REJECTED", "APPROVALREJECTED", "ERRORED"] then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as change_failure_rate,
median(d.stage_duration) / 1000.0 as median_lead_time,
count(case when (d.is_automated_rollback = true or d.rollback_duration > 0) then 1 end) as rollbacks,
max(d.end_ts) as last_deployed
}
| group_by org, project
| order_by deployments desc

widget.subtitle: Per org/project: volume, share of total, success, CFR (heat), lead time, rollbacks. Grouped by org

queries.query:
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${prj_filter_predicate} and ${pip_filter_predicate} and ${sts_filter_predicate}
| filter ${svc_filter_predicate} and ${env_filter_predicate} and ${ety_filter_predicate} and ${dty_filter_predicate}
| aggregate {
d.org_identifier as org,
d.project_identifier as project,
d.pipeline_identifier as pipeline,
d.pipeline_name as pipeline_name,
distinct_count(d.plan_execution_id) as runs,
distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) as deploy_stages,
round(100.0 * distinct_count(d.plan_execution_id) / sum(distinct_count(d.plan_execution_id)) over (), 1) as share_of_runs,

queries.query:
with s as (
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${prj_filter_predicate} and ${pip_filter_predicate} and ${sts_filter_predicate}
| filter ${svc_filter_predicate} and ${env_filter_predicate} and ${ety_filter_predicate} and ${dty_filter_predicate}
| filter d.service_identifier is not null and d.service_identifier != ""
| select {
d.org_identifier as org, d.project_identifier as project, d.service_identifier as service_id,
d.service_name as service, d.stage_status as status, d.env_name as env, d.stage_duration as dur,
d.start_ts as started, d.stage_execution_id as sid, (d.is_automated_rollback = true or d.rollback_duration > 0) as rb,
row_number() over (partition by d.project_identifier, d.service_identifier order by d.start_ts desc) as rn
}
)
find s
| aggregate {
s.org as org, s.project as project, s.service_id as service_id, s.service as service,
count() as deployments,
round(100.0 * count() / sum(count()) over (), 1) as share_of_total,
round(100.0 * count(case when s.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / count(), 1) as success_rate,
round(100.0 * count(case when s.status in ["FAILED", "ABORTED", "EXPIRED", "APPROVAL_REJECTED", "APPROVALREJECTED", "ERRORED"] then 1 end) / count(), 1) as change_failure_rate,
count(case when s.rb = true then 1 end) as rollbacks,
distinct_count(s.env) as environments,
median(s.dur) / 1000.0 as median_duration,
max(s.started) as last_deployed,
max(case when s.rn = 1 then s.status end) as last_status
}
| group_by org, project, service_id, service
| order_by deployments desc
| limit 100

widget.subtitle: Every service ranked by volume with share, success, CFR heat, rollbacks, reach and latest status

queries.query:
with e as (
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${prj_filter_predicate} and ${pip_filter_predicate} and ${sts_filter_predicate}
| filter ${svc_filter_predicate} and ${env_filter_predicate} and ${ety_filter_predicate} and ${dty_filter_predicate}
| filter d.env_identifier != ""
| select {
d.org_identifier as org, d.project_identifier as project, d.pipeline_identifier as pipeline,
d.plan_execution_id as exec_id, d.env_name as environment, d.env_type as env_type,
d.infra_name as infrastructure, d.deployment_type as deployment_type, d.service_identifier as svc,
d.stage_status as status, d.start_ts as started,
row_number() over (partition by d.project_identifier, d.env_identifier, d.infra_identifier order by d.start_ts desc) as rn,
count() over (partition by d.project_identifier, d.env_identifier, d.infra_identifier) as deployments,
count(case when d.stage_status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) over (partition by d.project_identifier, d.env_identifier, d.infra_identifier) as successes,
distinct_count(d.service_identifier) over (partition by d.project_identifier, d.env_identifier, d.infra_identifier) as services
}
)
find e
| filter e.rn = 1
| select {
e.org as org, e.project as project, e.pipeline as pipeline, e.exec_id as exec_id,
e.environment as environment, e.env_type as env_type, e.infrastructure as infrastructure,
e.deployment_type as deployment_type, e.services as services, e.deployments as deployments,
round(100.0 * e.successes / e.deployments, 1) as success_rate,
e.status as last_status, e.started as last_deployed
}
| order_by deployments desc
| limit 100

queries.query:
with f as (
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${prj_filter_predicate} and ${pip_filter_predicate} and ${sts_filter_predicate}
| filter ${svc_filter_predicate} and ${env_filter_predicate} and ${ety_filter_predicate} and ${dty_filter_predicate}
| filter d.service_identifier is not null and d.service_identifier != ""
| filter d.stage_status in ["FAILED", "ABORTED", "EXPIRED", "APPROVAL_REJECTED", "APPROVALREJECTED", "ERRORED"]
| select { d.service_identifier as svc, d.service_name as service, d.project_identifier as project,
d.stage_execution_id as fid, d.end_ts as fend }
),
r as (
find f
| join view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" s on s.service_identifier = f.svc and s.project_identifier = f.project
| filter s.stage_status = "SUCCESS" and s.start_ts > f.fend
| aggregate { f.fid as fid, f.service as service, f.project as project, min(f.fend) as fend, min(s.end_ts) as restored }
| group_by fid, service, project
)
find r
| aggregate {
r.project as project,
r.service as service,
count() as restored_failures,
avg(date_diff(r.fend, r.restored, "second")) as mean_ttr,
median(date_diff(r.fend, r.restored, "second")) as median_ttr,
max(date_diff(r.fend, r.restored, "second")) as worst_ttr
}
| group_by project, service
| order_by mean_ttr desc

widget.subtitle: Computed MTTR: each failure paired with the next success of the same service

queries.query:
with x as (
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${prj_filter_predicate} and ${pip_filter_predicate} and ${sts_filter_predicate}
| filter ${svc_filter_predicate} and ${env_filter_predicate} and ${ety_filter_predicate} and ${dty_filter_predicate}
| filter d.service_identifier is not null and d.service_identifier != ""
| filter d.stage_duration > 0
| select {
d.org_identifier as org, d.project_identifier as project, d.pipeline_identifier as pipeline,
d.plan_execution_id as exec_id, d.pipeline_name as execution, d.service_name as service,
d.env_name as environment, d.stage_status as status, d.start_ts as started,
d.stage_duration / 1000.0 as duration, avg(d.stage_duration) over () / 1000.0 as mean_duration
}
)
find x
| filter x.duration > 2 * x.mean_duration
| select {
x.org as org, x.project as project, x.pipeline as pipeline, x.exec_id as exec_id, x.execution as execution,
x.service as service, x.environment as environment, x.status as status, x.started as started,
x.duration as duration, x.mean_duration as mean_duration,
round(x.duration / x.mean_duration, 1) as x_mean
}
| order_by duration desc
| limit 100

widget.subtitle: Anomalies: deployments that took more than twice the average duration

queries.query:
find view "opa:policy_evaluation_result_view" o
| join view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d on d.plan_execution_id = o.plan_execution_id
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${prj_filter_predicate} and ${pip_filter_predicate} and ${sts_filter_predicate}
| filter ${svc_filter_predicate} and ${env_filter_predicate} and ${ety_filter_predicate} and ${dty_filter_predicate}
| filter o.evaluation_created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and o.evaluation_created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| aggregate {
d.org_identifier as org, d.project_identifier as project, d.pipeline_identifier as pipeline,
d.plan_execution_id as exec_id, d.pipeline_name as execution,
max(o.evaluation_created) as evaluated_at, o.policyset_name as policy_set, o.policy_name as policy,
o.policy_status as policy_status, o.policy_severity as severity, o.evaluation_action as action,
max(d.stage_status) as deployment_status, distinct_count(d.service_identifier) as services
}
| group_by org, project, pipeline, exec_id, execution, policy_set, policy, policy_status, severity, action

queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:step_execution" s
| join view "cd:pipeline_execution_summary_cd" p on p.planexecutionid = s.plan_execution_id
| filter s.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter s.step_type in ["HarnessApproval", "JiraApproval", "ServiceNowApproval", "CustomApproval"]
| filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${prj_filter_predicate} and ${pip_filter_predicate} and ${sts_filter_predicate}
| left join view "cd:step_execution_summary_harness_approval" a on a.step_execution_id = s.step_execution_id
| aggregate {
case when a.approval_action = "APPROVE" then "Approved"
when a.approval_action = "REJECT" then "Rejected"
when s.status = "EXPIRED" then "Expired"
when s.status = "ABORTED" then "Aborted"
else s.status end as outcome,
distinct_count(s.step_execution_id) as gates
}
| group_by outcome
| order_by gates desc

queries.query:
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${prj_filter_predicate} and ${pip_filter_predicate} and ${sts_filter_predicate}
| filter ${svc_filter_predicate} and ${env_filter_predicate} and ${ety_filter_predicate} and ${dty_filter_predicate}
| filter date_diff(date_trunc("week", d.start_ts), d.start_ts, "day") >= 5 or cast(date_diff(date_trunc("day", d.start_ts), d.start_ts, "hour") as int) < 8 or cast(date_diff(date_trunc("day", d.start_ts), d.start_ts, "hour") as int) >= 18
| select {
d.org_identifier as org, d.project_identifier as project, d.pipeline_identifier as pipeline,
d.plan_execution_id as exec_id, d.pipeline_name as execution,
d.start_ts as started, case when date_diff(date_trunc("week", d.start_ts), d.start_ts, "day") < 1 then "1 Mon" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", d.start_ts), d.start_ts, "day") < 2 then "2 Tue" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", d.start_ts), d.start_ts, "day") < 3 then "3 Wed" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", d.start_ts), d.start_ts, "day") < 4 then "4 Thu" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", d.start_ts), d.start_ts, "day") < 5 then "5 Fri" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", d.start_ts), d.start_ts, "day") < 6 then "6 Sat" else "7 Sun" end as weekday, cast(date_diff(date_trunc("day", d.start_ts), d.start_ts, "hour") as int) as hour_utc,
case when d.service_name = "" then "(custom stage)" else d.service_name end as service,
d.env_name as environment, d.env_type as env_type, d.stage_status as status,
date_diff(date_trunc("week", d.start_ts), d.start_ts, "day") >= 5 as is_weekend
}
| order_by started desc
| limit 200

widget.title: Services Never Deployed in Period

queries.query:
with dep as (
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| aggregate { d.project_identifier as pid, d.service_identifier as sid, d.env_identifier as eid,
d.infra_identifier as iid, d.pipeline_identifier as plid, count() as n, max(d.start_ts) as last }
| group_by pid, sid, eid, iid, plid
)
find entity "cd:service" a
| left join dep on dep.sid = a.identifier and dep.pid = a.project_identifier
| filter a.created_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter a.deleted = false and dep.sid is null
| filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${prj_filter_predicate}
| select {
a.org_identifier as org, a.project_identifier as project, a.identifier as service_id, a.name as service,
a.type as type, a.store_type as store_type, a.git_ops_enabled as gitops, a.created_at as created,
a.last_updated_at as last_updated
}
| order_by created desc
| limit 200

widget.title: CD Pipeline Inventory & Activity

queries.query:
with dep as (
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| aggregate { d.project_identifier as pid, d.service_identifier as sid, d.env_identifier as eid,
d.infra_identifier as iid, d.pipeline_identifier as plid, count() as n, max(d.start_ts) as last }
| group_by pid, sid, eid, iid, plid
)
find entity "pipeline:pipeline" a
| join dep on dep.plid = a.identifier and dep.pid = a.project_identifier
| filter a.created_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${prj_filter_predicate}
| aggregate {
a.org_identifier as org, a.project_identifier as project, a.identifier as pipeline, a.name as pipeline_name,
a.store_type as store_type, a.repo as repo, max(a.created_at) as created,
sum(dep.n) as deploy_stages, distinct_count(dep.sid) as services, max(dep.last) as last_deployed,
date_diff(max(dep.last), cast(${end_time} as timestamp), "day") as days_since_deploy
}
| group_by org, project, pipeline, pipeline_name, store_type, repo
| order_by deploy_stages desc
